Anonymous usage statistics

This app enables anonymous usage statistics by default to understand active device counts and feature usage. We collect app version, language, deck, and the number of cards drawn; we do not collect email addresses, questions, specific draw results, or local history. To prevent abuse, the server reads only the connection country (country level) and never records the raw IP address. You can turn it off below at any time; turning it off stops all statistics and deletes this device\'s anonymous identifier.
